name: Hespic Vessic
keeps: what grows on her side of the wall
does: Signs at one door and no other. If she will not sign, that door does not move.
reason: The word alchemy carries an Arabic article on the front of it because of this tradition.
text: Hespic vessic of the open ledger, keeps a door for the 12th tranche, doors 105 to 114. Keeps what grows on her side of the wall. Reads Jabir ibn Hayyan (Geber).
